findings.summary: Edward Coristine (19, alias 'Big Balls'): fired from Path Network cybersecurity internship in 2022 for leaking proprietary information to competitors; posted on Discord that he maintained unauthorized access post-termination; linked to cybercrime group EGodly via DiamondCDN LLC CDN services; tracked by law enforcement under aliases Rivage and JoeyCrafter for DDoS-for-hire solicitation (Nov 2022). Despite this background held simultaneous positions at OPM, DHS/CISA, USAID, State Dept, GSA with A-suite GSA clearance. Reported directly to Amanda Scales (OPM Chief of Staff, ex-xAI). Moved to SSA (June 2025) then National Design Studio (Dec 2025). Grandfather is Valery Martinov. CT companies: DiamondCDN LLC, MISTDECK LLC, TESLA.SEXY LLC.

DiamondCDN LLC (entity #920), registered August 23 2022 in Connecticut at 26 Lakeview Ave New Canaan CT, was operated by Coristine (alias Rivage) and provided DDoS protection and caching services to EGodly cybercrime group from October 2022 to June 2023. EGodly thanked DiamondCDN on Telegram February 15 2023. EGodly boasted about hijacking phone numbers, trafficking stolen PII, hacking law enforcement emails, and cyberstalking an FBI agent in Wilmington DE (distributed his address, photos, drove by his house). Coristine solicited DDoS-for-hire services in Dstat Discord channel November 2022.

Coristine grandfather Valery Martynov was a Soviet KGB officer (Line X - technical espionage division) who became a double agent for CIA/FBI under codename 'Gentile' starting 1982. Betrayed by CIA traitor Aldrich Ames and executed by KGB May 28 1987. Martynov's daughter Anna (Coristine's mother) became a financial professional who married Charles Coristine, owner of LesserEvil snack company. This family history was flagged in security clearance context: Coristine received unrestricted federal system access without standard background checks.

Path Network firing (2022): Coristine, age 17, was fired as intern at Arizona-based cybersecurity firm Path Network in June 2022 for leaking internal proprietary information to competitors. Executive message confirmed: 'Edward has been terminated for leaking internal information to the competitors.' CEO Marshal Webb had defended keeping him to avoid making him 'an enemy.' Less than two months post-termination, Coristine posted in Discord (as 'Rivage') that he maintained access to Path Network systems: 'I had access to all the game hosting machines for months after termination.' A large collection of internal Path documents was subsequently leaked online.

TESLA.SEXY LLC (entity #896), registered 2021 when Coristine was ~16, controls dozens of web domains including at least two Russian-registered domains. One active Russian domain offers an AI Discord bot (Helfie) targeting the Russian market. Tesla.Sexy LLC is the only one of Coristine's three CT companies still active. A Discord server associated with Tesla.Sexy LLC contained audio (Nov 6 2021) of members conducting doxing and harassment, and references to membership in hacker communities Anonymous and Verm Squad.

Coristine government access profile (2025): Received unrestricted access across OPM, DHS/CISA, USAID, State Department, and GSA simultaneously with A-suite GSA clearance - all without standard background checks that would have flagged EGodly/cybercrime history. Career path: Neuralink (brief) -> DOGE (Jan 2025) -> SSA (June 2025) -> National Design Studio under Joe Gebbia (Dec 2025). At National Design Studio, credited with building websites and branding for Trump administration's 'Genesis' AI mission with a team of 3. Beaten in DC carjacking attempt August 3 2025; attack became pretext for Trump law-enforcement surge in DC.
